err.groupArea: This group has no area — there's nothing to seal its name with.
err.formArea: A form needs an area — the name lies under its key.
err.nameLocked: This form's name can't be opened — without it you can't move it to another area.

imp.groupNoArea: Group “{name}”: the form has no area yet — the group can't be created.
imp.groupMade: Group “{name}” created, the form is in it.
imp.roleNotHeld: You don't have the role {id}… — skipped.

wish.groupWill: Group: “{name}” (if it doesn't exist — it will be created).
wish.designFromDoc: Layout and logic: from the document.
wish.repeatOnlyExt: "repeat" only a form extension has — skipped.
wish.repeatHasEntries: This extension already has entries — "repeat" stays unchanged.
wish.rolesNone: Participant roles: none (whoever already belongs stays).
wish.rolesFromDoc: Participant roles: from the document — those you have.
wish.audienceHasEntries: This sub-form already has entries — "audience" stays unchanged.

pick.belongs: Questions and submissions belong to the module — open it to arrange them.
pick.areaIsKey: The area is the key — the answers will lie under it.

settings.ownArea: This module's area is the people who answer — you set them below, in “Content”.
settings.sealedHint: Questions are sealed with this area's key — everyone who reads this area reads them. Answers go wherever each question directs them.
settings.hasData: This module already has data — the area can't be changed. What was sealed with the old key stays under it.
settings.reseal: On saving, all questions (and the layout with logic) will be resealed with the new area's key. Collected answers stay where they are.

json.answersTo: Answers to new questions go to the area
json.asGiven: — as given in the question / the form's area —
json.answersHint: Whoever has this area's key reads the answers. A form without its own area gets this area.
json.replace: Delete questions and requirements not in the document (questions with answers are only taken off the form — their answers stay; questions of switched-on requirements can't be deleted)
json.wholePage: This is a document of a whole page — import it in the page editor.
json.otherKind: This is a module of kind “{doc}”, and “{open}” is open.
json.pickArea: Choose the area answers go to — the form has no own area yet, and without it new questions and requirements won't be created.
json.otherModule: The document comes from another module — its content will be moved here.
json.lead: The name and content of this module as JSON. The import changes this module on every page it stands on — without creating it anew.
json.leadForm: The name and content of this module, its questions, layout and requirements as JSON. The import changes this module on every page it stands on — without creating it anew.

page.depMapSub: Pages, modules and sources — what uses what
page.none: You don't have any module of this kind yet.
page.noSettings: This kind has no settings of its own — everything it shows comes from elsewhere.

unused.ask: Delete these modules? This can't be undone.
unused.kept: Staying, because they have submissions: {list}. Submissions belong to the people who sent them.

new.title: New: {kind}
new.areaHint: The area is the key — this module's data will lie under it.

dep.askAdd: Add “{name}” to the page {path}? It will appear at the end of the page.
dep.askLinkAsk: Attach the form “{name}” to “{target}”? Whoever filled it in will be able to start a conversation there.
dep.askLinkChannel: Attach the form “{name}” to: {chat}? Whoever filled it in will read this channel.
dep.askLinkChat: Attach the form “{name}” to: {chat}? Whoever filled it in will read and write in this conversation.
dep.noSource: The module “{kind}” doesn't take data from: {source}.
dep.askRemove: Take “{name}” off the page {path}? The module stays — it can be placed again.
dep.askUnlinkAsk: Detach the form “{name}”? Whoever filled it in won't start conversations here any more (started ones stay).
dep.askUnlinkChat: Detach the form “{name}”? Whoever filled it in will stop seeing this conversation.
dep.askRemoveSubject: Take “Choice on the page” off the page {path}? “Person panel” modules will stop showing anyone there.
dep.lede: Pages, modules and where modules take their data from. Drag a line from a page to a module to place it on the page, or from a module to a calendar, library, conversation, form or page to set the source (e.g. “List of people” → form and the person's page) — from a form to a conversation or channel so the people who filled it in are in it. Select a line and press Delete to remove it. Double-click opens the thing.
dep.onlyUsed: only modules that are on pages
